title: A Prayer for Today
text: Father, give me strength today. Order my steps and quiet my worries. Let Your peace lead everything I say and do. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Wisdom
text: Lord, when I don't know the way, be my light. Give me a wise and understanding heart, and help me trust You over my own plans. Amen.

title: A Prayer of Gratitude
text: Thank You, Father, for another day. For breath, for family, for grace I did not earn. Let my heart stay grateful no matter what today brings. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Peace
text: God of peace, still the noise around me and within me. Remind me that You are near, and that nothing today is bigger than You. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Strength
text: Father, when I am weary, be my strength. Carry what I cannot carry, and remind me that Your grace is sufficient for this day. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Others
text: Lord, bring to my mind someone who needs encouragement today. Use my words, my time, or my silence to point them toward You. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Guidance
text: Father, direct my decisions today. Close the doors I should not walk through, and give me courage for the ones I should. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Healing
text: Lord, You are the healer of hearts and bodies. Touch what is broken in me and in those I love, and give patience while we wait on You. Amen.

title: A Morning Prayer
text: Good morning, Father. Before anything else fills my mind, let me remember You are already at work in this day. Lead me. Amen.

title: An Evening Prayer
text: Lord, thank You for this day, the good and the hard parts alike. Settle my heart tonight and let me rest in Your care. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Patience
text: Father, teach me to wait well. Where I want to rush, help me trust Your timing instead of my own. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Joy
text: Lord, let Your joy be my strength today, not because everything is easy, but because You are good. Amen.
